title: Asparagus Summer Soup
description: This asparagus summer soup recipe blends cream of asparagus soup with spinach and leeks, which creates an appetizing shade of summertime green.
ingredients: 1 pound fresh asparagus, trimmed and peeled
2 leeks, white and light green parts only, thinly sliced
0.5 cup heavy whipping cream, or more to taste

steps.text: Cut asparagus stalks into 1-inch pieces; set tips aside.

Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add ⅓ cup broth and leeks; cover and cook until leeks are tender, about 5 minutes. Add asparagus stalks; cover and cook 3 minutes more.

Add remaining 4 ⅔ cups broth to the Dutch oven; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer until asparagus is very tender, 10 to 12 minutes. Add 2 packed cups spinach and sugar; cook until spinach is tender, about 5 minutes.
Purée soup with an immersion blender until very smooth.
Heat remaining 3 tablespoons butter in a small saucepan. Whisk in flour until well blended; cook for 1 minute.

Whisk flour mixture into soup until smooth; season with salt and white pepper. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and stir in peas. Simmer until peas are barely tender, about 3 minutes. Stir in reserved asparagus tips; simmer until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add heavy cream; cook until heated through but not boiling, 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in remaining spinach; cook until heated through, about 3 minutes more.
